title: Gripper 7: Robot shop assistant (MuJoCo)
description: Gripper 6's mobile manipulator with a choice of gripper (soft fingers, rigid jaws, three-jaw chuck, suction cup), arm (UR-like, KUKA LBR iiwa, Franka Panda) and cart (omniwheels, two-wheel drive, tracks, car steering). Click an item and the robot stocks it by itself, or let it stock its whole crate.
